XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia xAPI / LRS — statement store and cmi5 session tables. P1.4 from GAP-ANALYSIS-INVINCE-LXP-2026-06-16.md.

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_xapi_stmts
TABLE.COMMENT: xAPI 1.0.3 statement store. One row per statement. Indexed for actor / verb / object / tenant lookups. Statements are immutable once stored (xAPI spec §2.5). Rows are purged by the cleanup task after retention_days.

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Surrogate primary key (LRS-internal)

FIELD.NAME: statementid
FIELD.COMMENT: xAPI statement UUID (client-supplied or LRS-generated). Unique per tenant.

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root: 1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA. 0=platform-level (internal emitter).

FIELD.NAME: actorid
FIELD.COMMENT: Resolved Moodle userid. NULL when the actor could not be resolved to a local user (external xAPI client).

FIELD.NAME: actor
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded xAPI actor object (Agent or Group). Contains IFI — may include email.

FIELD.NAME: verb
FIELD.COMMENT: Verb IRI (e.g. http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/completed). Stored flat for index efficiency.

FIELD.NAME: verbdisplay
FIELD.COMMENT: Verb display value in en-US (denormalised for UI rendering without JSON parse).

FIELD.NAME: object
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded xAPI object (Activity, Agent, SubStatement, StatementRef).

FIELD.NAME: objectid
FIELD.COMMENT: Object IRI (denormalised for lookup). Capped at 1333 — Moodle's VARCHAR max; the full IRI is always present in the `object` JSON column, so no data is lost for the rare IRI > 1333 chars.

FIELD.NAME: result
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded xAPI result (score, success, completion, response, duration).

FIELD.NAME: score_scaled
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised result.score.scaled (-1.0 to 1.0) for aggregate queries without JSON parse.

FIELD.NAME: score_raw
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised result.score.raw for aggregate queries.

FIELD.NAME: success
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised result.success (0/1/NULL). NULL = not provided.

FIELD.NAME: completion
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised result.completion (0/1/NULL).

FIELD.NAME: context
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded xAPI context (registration, contextActivities, extensions).

FIELD.NAME: registration
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised context.registration UUID (cmi5 session UUID). Indexed for cmi5 queries.

FIELD.NAME: authority
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded authority (LRS-assigned or forwarded from upstream LRS).

FIELD.NAME: timestamp
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp from the statement timestamp field (may differ from stored).

FIELD.NAME: stored
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when the LRS stored the statement. Set by the LRS, never by client.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Origin of the statement: moodle (event observer) | lrs (external POST to endpoint) | import.

FIELD.NAME: voided
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = statement has been voided by a VoidedStatement (xAPI spec §4.2.2). Not deleted — kept for audit.

KEY.NAME: uk_stmt_tenant
KEY.COMMENT: xAPI spec: statement IDs must be unique within an LRS. We scope to tenant.

INDEX.NAME: idx_costcenter
INDEX.COMMENT: Tenant filter — all admin queries start here

INDEX.NAME: idx_actorid
INDEX.COMMENT: Per-user statement history (privacy export, LRS viewer)

INDEX.NAME: idx_verb
INDEX.COMMENT: Filter by verb IRI (e.g. all completed statements)

INDEX.NAME: idx_stored
INDEX.COMMENT: Chronological ordering and retention purge (WHERE stored < cutoff)

INDEX.NAME: idx_registration
INDEX.COMMENT: cmi5 session lookup by registration UUID

INDEX.NAME: idx_cid_actor_verb
INDEX.COMMENT: Compound for per-user per-verb aggregates (completion rates, pass rates)

INDEX.NAME: idx_voided
INDEX.COMMENT: Exclude voided statements from most queries

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_xapi_cmi5
TABLE.COMMENT: cmi5 Assignable Unit (AU) session records. Tracks the lifecycle of a cmi5 launch: initialized → [pass|fail|complete] → terminated (or suspended/resumed). One row per (userid, courseid, registration) triple. The registration UUID links back to xAPI statements.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_course.id (the course the AU belongs to)

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_course_modules.id (the SCORM/activity cm, nullable for external AU)

FIELD.NAME: registration
FIELD.COMMENT: cmi5 registration UUID — links this session to xAPI statements via context.registration

FIELD.NAME: activityid
FIELD.COMMENT: cmi5 AU activity IRI (launchURL activity id). Capped at 1333 — Moodle's VARCHAR max.

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: cmi5 sessionId (per-launch UUID, supplied by the LRS at launch)

FIELD.NAME: launchtoken
FIELD.COMMENT: One-time fetch token provided at launch (cmi5 spec §8.2). Cleared after first use.

FIELD.NAME: launchmode
FIELD.COMMENT: cmi5 launchMode: Normal | Browse | Review

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Session status: initialized | passed | failed | completed | terminated | suspended | abandoned

FIELD.NAME: score_scaled
FIELD.COMMENT: Final score scaled (-1.0 to 1.0) when terminated

FIELD.NAME: success
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=failed, 1=passed, NULL=not yet determined

FIELD.NAME: duration
FIELD.COMMENT: ISO 8601 duration (e.g. PT5M30S) from terminated statement

FIELD.NAME: timeinitialized
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of initialized statement

FIELD.NAME: timeterminated
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of terminated statement

KEY.NAME: uk_registration
KEY.COMMENT: Each cmi5 session has a unique registration UUID

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_xapi_clients
TABLE.COMMENT: Registered xAPI client credentials (per-tenant). Supports Bearer token and HTTP Basic auth patterns. Each client can be scoped to a tenant and optionally restricted by IP CIDR allowlist.

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant scope: 0=platform-wide, >0=tenant-specific

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable client name (e.g. 'SCORM content player', 'Partner LMS')

FIELD.NAME: token_hash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 hash of the Bearer token. NULL when basic-auth only.

FIELD.NAME: basic_user
FIELD.COMMENT: HTTP Basic auth username. NULL when token-only.

FIELD.NAME: basic_pass_hash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 hash of the Basic auth password.

FIELD.NAME: ip_allowlist
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated CIDR ranges. NULL = any IP allowed.

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = credential revoked but row kept for audit
